blurb: When camping in the Black Hills of South Dakota there’s one camping destination that has it all … Fish ’N Fry Campground! We have trout fishing, a heated pool, “Big-Rig” RV sites, cabins, tenting, a complete menu café and more. Located 5 miles from Deadwood, South Dakota and near The Black Hills National Forest on US Hwy 385, we are convenient to Mt. Rushmore, Custer State Park, Sturgis, and hundreds of ATV trails!
